faqs_list.question: Can I upgrade or downgrade my plan at any time?
faqs_list.answer: Absolutely! Flexibility is key. You can change plans whenever you like. Upgrades are calculated pro-rata for the remaining days of the billing cycle, while downgrades take effect in the next cycle.

faqs_list.question: What happens after the trial period ends?
faqs_list.answer: Your data remains safe on our servers. You will be asked to choose a paid plan to keep using premium features. If you don't choose in 7 days, your account will automatically return to the Free plan.

faqs_list.question: How does the payment model work?
faqs_list.answer: The EO plan uses a flat monthly subscription model. No per-athlete fees, allowing you to manage your tournament budget with absolute predictability.

faqs_list.question: How long does implementation take for the Elite plan?
faqs_list.answer: For Elite plans, we typically set up all custom configurations within 3-5 business days. You will also receive dedicated training sessions for your organization's administrators.
